moments.title: England Red Roses' Winning Streak Ends
moments.blurb: England's Red Roses drew 26-26 with Canada in Exeter today, ending their incredible 39-game winning streak in a thrilling match.

angles.name: Exeter Local Heroics
angles.copy: What a game at Sandy Park today! The Red Roses' winning streak ends but what a performance from both sides in Exeter. Were you there?

angles.name: National Rugby News
angles.copy: The Red Roses' incredible 39-game winning streak is OVER! A nail-biting 26-26 draw with Canada in Exeter. What a match!

moments.title: Welsh Cup Giant-Killing by Llysfaen
moments.blurb: Tier 5 side Llysfaen caused a sensation today, coming from behind with 10 men to knock out a fourth-tier team in the Welsh Cup.

angles.name: Local Football Pride
angles.copy: Unbelievable scenes in the Welsh Cup today! Huge congratulations to Llysfaen on their incredible giant-killing victory. What a result for North Wales football!
